excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past decade, the market's vision of "AI assistants" has undergone three major rounds of expectation calibration. The first was with the birth of Siri, where voice control brought a novelty in interaction, leading people to believe that the intelligent butler Jarvis from movies was within reach, only to later find it was often just a voice-activated alarm clock. The second was the emergence of ChatGPT, whose fluent conversation and reasoning abilities made it seem like AI had finally gained a "brain," but the market soon realized it remained merely a sage confined to dialog boxes, unaware of the world beyond. In early 2025, the appearance of Manus gave tangible reality to the concept of an Agent. This impact was different from before—many saw for the first time that AI was not only "talking" but also "doing." It opened browsers, wrote code, debugged errors right before your eyes, and even proactively refreshed pages when loading was too slow. As the hype around Manus gradually subsided following its acquisition, people realized that, regardless of how the technological shell evolves, humanity's core desire for AI assistants has never changed: users don't just want a chat companion that merely understands speech, nor do they only want a geek tool that writes code in a black-and-white interface; what everyone has always wanted is...

La segunda ocurrió con la aparición de ChatGPT, cuya fluidez en el diálogo y capacidad de razonamiento hicieron pensar que la IA finalmente tenía "cerebro", pero rápidamente el mercado se dio cuenta de que seguía siendo solo una inteligencia que debatía en un cuadro de diálogo.

items.raw_excerpt: 1月14日消息，阿里Qoder上线能自我学习与快速进化的自主智能体Quest 1.0，该智能体无需用户干预，即可自主理解需求、规划方案、修复BUG并最终验证交付，真正让不懂代码的用户也能完成应用开发，推动AI 编程进入自主进化时代。   阿里Qoder上线能自我学习与快速进化的自主智能体Quest 1.0 现有主流AI 编程工具需要开发者持续关注AI的执行过程，并需要人力审查AI生成的内容、手动纠正错误。Qoder上线的Quest 1.0在集成全球顶尖Coding模型的基础之上，创新性应用了自进化智能体（Self-Evolving Agent ），能深度分析项目代码结构、架构演进以及团队规范等，并实现自我学习与进化。  面对复杂工程时，全新的Qoder Quest不会直接写代码，而是先生成技术规约（Spec），明确需求边界、技术选型、验收标准，同时通过内置的多个子智能体并行探索不同实现路径，择优而行，有效提升代码生成效果。遇到代码报错时，Qoder Quest还能自动诊断根因、生成修复方案、验证修复效果，直到问题解决，整个过程无需人类持续介入。 据介绍，Qoder Quest还新增支持 Skills功能，让智能体学会更多的技能，比如编写规约（Spec）、制作网站、设计原型、处理文档等标准化技能包，极大地拓展了AI编程的能力边界。 Qoder 负责人丁宇表示：“AI 编程经历了从代码补全到结对编程的演进，但本质上还是工具思维，即「AI做一步，人确认一步」，Quest 1.0代表全新的范式。我们希望不仅仅是创造一个更好的工具，还是一个会学习、会反思、会进化的AI工程师。”

excerpt_i18n.zh: 1月14日消息，阿里Qoder上线能自我学习与快速进化的自主智能体Quest 1.0，该智能体无需用户干预，即可自主理解需求、规划方案、修复BUG并最终验证交付，真正让不懂代码的用户也能完成应用开发，推动AI 编程进入自主进化时代。   阿里Qoder上线能自我学习与快速进化的自主智能体Quest 1.0 现有主流AI 编程工具需要开发者持续关注AI的执行过程，并需要人力审查AI生成的内容、手动纠正错误。Qoder上线的Quest 1.0在集成全球顶尖Coding模型的基础之上，创新性应用了自进化智能体（Self-Evolving Agent ），能深度分析项目代码结构、架构演进以及团队规范等，并实现自我学习与进化。  面对复杂工程时，全新的Qoder Quest不会直接写代码，而是先生成技术规约（Spec），明确需求边界、技术选型、验收标准，同时通过内置的多个子智能体并行探索不同实现路径，择优而行，有效提升代码生成效果。遇到代码报错时，Qoder Quest还能自动诊断根因、生成修复方案、验证修复效果，直到问题解决，整个过程无需人类持续介入。 据介绍，Qoder Quest还新增支持 Skills功能，让智能体学会更多的技能，比如编写规约（Spec）、制作网站、设计原型、处理文档等标准化技能包，极大地拓展了AI编程的能力边界。 Qoder 负责人丁宇表示：“AI 编程经历了从代码补全到结对编程的演进，但本质上还是工具思维，即「AI做一步，人确认一步」，Quest 1.0代表全新的范式。我们希望不仅仅是创造一个更好的工具，还是一个会学习、会反思、会进化的AI工程师。”
excerpt_i18n.en:
On January 14, Alibaba Qoder launched Quest 1.0, a self-learning and rapidly evolving autonomous agent. This agent can independently understand requirements, plan solutions, fix bugs, and ultimately verify and deliver results without user intervention, enabling even users without coding knowledge to complete application development and advancing AI programming into an era of autonomous evolution.

Existing mainstream AI programming tools require developers to continuously monitor the AI's execution process, manually review AI-generated content, and correct errors. Building on the integration of top global coding models, Quest 1.0 on Qoder innovatively applies a Self-Evolving Agent, capable of deeply analyzing project code structure, architectural evolution, and team standards to achieve self-learning and evolution.

When tackling complex engineering tasks, the new Qoder Quest does not directly write code. Instead, it first generates technical specifications (Spec) to clarify requirement boundaries, technology selections, and acceptance criteria. Simultaneously, it utilizes multiple built-in sub-agents to explore different implementation paths in parallel, selecting the optimal approach to effectively enhance code generation outcomes. When encountering code errors, Qoder Quest can automatically diagnose root causes, generate fixes, and verify the effectiveness of repairs until the issue is resolved.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 14 de enero, Alibaba Qoder lanzó el agente autónomo inteligente Quest 1.0, capaz de autoaprendizaje y evolución rápida. Este agente puede comprender necesidades, planificar soluciones, corregir errores y validar entregas sin intervención del usuario, permitiendo incluso a quienes no entienden de código completar el desarrollo de aplicaciones, impulsando así la programación con IA hacia una era de evolución autónoma. A diferencia de las principales herramientas de programación con IA actuales, que requieren que los desarrolladores supervisen continuamente el proceso de ejecución de la IA y revisen manualmente su contenido generado para corregirlo.
